status.summary: Former UFC welterweight champion, pro record 22-6 (1 NC). He won the title by head-kick KO of Kamaru Usman at UFC 278 (Aug 20, 2022), defended it against Usman (UFC 286, Mar 18, 2023) and Colby Covington (UFC 296, Dec 16, 2023), and lost it to Belal Muhammad at UFC 304 (Jul 27, 2024). He has lost three straight: Muhammad (UD), Sean Brady (guillotine R4, London, Mar 22, 2025) and Carlos Prates (KO R2 1:28, UFC 322, Nov 15, 2025), and has not fought since. A bout with Daniel Rodriguez at UFC 329 (Jul 11, 2026) was reported in April 2026 but never happened; Rodriguez said Edwards' side 'were leaning towards another direction'. Uros Medic called him out after UFC Belgrade (Aug 1, 2026). No fight booked, and no injury or retirement announcement found, as of Nov 6, 2026.

style.summary: A southpaw kickboxer who works at range with straight punches and kicks to the legs, body and head, and is accurate rather than busy. His biggest wins came from kicks: the head-kick KO of Usman, and 86 leg and body strikes landed in their third fight (UFC 286). Since 2024, wrestlers have controlled him for long spells and his output has dropped. He has lost his last three and has not fought since November 2025.

moves.notes: Target split from the fighters.json S sums: decayed significant attempts go 62.2% head, 19.7% body, 18.2% legs, and landed strikes 46.6% head, 26.1% body, 27.3% legs. Career attempts are 71.3/16.6/12.1. Body and legs are well above the welterweight attempt rates (13.9% and 9.3%), so body kicks (0.5) and low kicks (calf 0.4, inside 0.3) get the most weight. Distance body strikes are taken to be mostly kicks, since his biggest body totals came at distance (36/39 vs Usman at UFC 286). That is a judgment: ufcstats does not separate punches from kicks. Head kick is 0.18 because of the Usman KO. Clinch strikes are 13.0% of his decayed landed strikes (division 9.9%), so knees get 0.2 and elbows 0.15. The hand split (right jab vs left straight vs hook) is not in ufcstats and follows his southpaw jab-and-straight game as a judgment, not a count. Spinning 0.03 is a token: none of his finishes are spinning strikes. The Nov 6, 2026 web pass re-checked status and appearance only; these technique weights still rest on ufcstats alone, with no outside technique breakdown.

engine_notes.note: Five-round experience: 9 scheduled five-round fights. His output is flat across rounds (round 5 at 0.99x round 1 over 34 min of round-5 data), so he neither fades nor surges.
Grappling has become the hole: decayed takedown defense 53.9% (division 64.1%) and 292 s controlled per 15 min (division 167). Usman also controlled him 10:36 at UFC 278 before the head-kick KO.
Chin: 2 knockdowns absorbed in 20 UFC fights (Barberena 2017, Prates 2025) and 1 KO loss (Prates).

Inactivity: last fight 2025-11-15, about 12 months before the as-of date, coming off his first KO loss. A July 2026 bout with Daniel Rodriguez never materialised and nothing is booked as of Nov 6, 2026.
